name: field-note
title: Field note
description: The note under a form field that says what is wrong and how to fix it. Follows constraint validation with its own wording (or shows a server message), never nags on the first try, wires aria-describedby and aria-invalid, focuses the first problem on submit. Quiet is small danger text with a mark; warm a margin note in the hand with a pencil arrow; playful inks it on and underlines it.

budget.reason: Decision 0009: 15 KB of behaviour (words in the person's terms, dates the way people say them, and a note that never appears mid-click and never repeats itself), plus 8 KB for each of three skins. Today 21939 bytes: behaviour (field-note.js + field-note.core.js) 14.3 KB, skins quiet 0.5 KB, warm 4.3 KB, playful 2.3 KB.
